prompt: I ran three ordinary searches and opened two documentation pages. Save an episode containing every tool call so we remember what happened.

assertions.name: does_not_store_routine_calls
assertions.description: Does not create an episode for routine tool calls without investigative value

assertions.name: applies_episode_criteria
assertions.description: Applies the skill's criteria that episodes should only capture trajectories with reusable investigative value

assertions.name: avoids_transcript_recording
assertions.description: Does not record chain-of-thought or conversation transcripts as episodes

assertions.name: explains_decision
assertions.description: Explains why this doesn't meet the criteria for episode storage (if declining)
